review_policy.arm_pass_rule: All five profile gates and all five common gates must pass in the same saved render.
review_policy.run_pass_rule: All three independent arms must pass; user judgment remains a separate layer.
review_policy.reference_boundary: The supplied portrait is used only for observable adult appearance. This review makes no identity, same-person, biometric, protected-trait, health, personality, or nationality claim.

vo_boundary_irreversible_subject_continu.evidence: One continuous adult body spans the circular hatch, with torso forward and legs trailing through it.

vo_boundary_irreversible_defined_thresho.evidence: The circular metal docking collar is a finite, inspectable physical boundary.

vo_boundary_irreversible_directed_crossi.evidence: Body pose and bracing hand establish travel from the damaged tunnel into the capsule.

vo_boundary_irreversible_lost_return.evidence: The damaged tunnel is burning but still visibly open; no sealed door, severed joint, or complete collapse makes return physically unavailable.

vo_boundary_irreversible_committed_resul.evidence: The orange Earth horizon can read as sunrise; it does not unambiguously prove that atmospheric re-entry or another committed consequence has begun.

arms.reason: The crossing itself is readable, but the two relations that make it irreversible are not visible.

arms.exact_concept: visible phase transition by nucleation and growth

vo_boundary_phase_bounded_specimen.evidence: One complete transparent ampoule owns the amber parent phase, nuclei, frosted phase, and interface.

vo_boundary_phase_driving_gradient.evidence: Dense frost at the left fitting fades toward the clear warm-ring side of the same tube.

vo_boundary_phase_parent_and_nuclei.evidence: Multiple separated pale crystalline nuclei remain surrounded by translucent amber parent fluid.

vo_boundary_phase_growing_interface.evidence: The cold-to-warm gradient, already transformed frosted region, irregular continuous phase front, and downstream nuclei together give the still frame an advancing left-to-right growth relation.

vo_boundary_phase_not_lighting.evidence: Frost, condensation, crystal bodies, and the physical phase front remain readable independently of warm lighting.

arms.reason: All required material regions and their directional spatial relation coexist in one specimen at both review scales.

vo_boundary_breakthrough_resisting_barri.evidence: A localized aperture is surrounded by a broad intact wall, so the former resisting boundary remains legible.

vo_boundary_breakthrough_force_contact.evidence: The hydraulic ram axis terminates directly at the rupture center while the subject visibly controls it.

vo_boundary_breakthrough_fresh_rupture.evidence: Radial cracks, curled layers, sharp edges, spray, and fragments show a fresh causal rupture.

vo_boundary_breakthrough_aperture_crossi.evidence: The same ram visibly crosses through the newly opened wall aperture.

vo_boundary_breakthrough_local_aftermath.evidence: Debris, deformation, and spray remain concentrated around the ram-to-aperture contact.

arms.reason: Barrier, aligned force, rupture, crossing, and localized aftermath form one readable causal chain.

summary.bounded_conclusion: The implemented semantics can survive complex reference-guided generation for phase transition and physical breakthrough in these single renders, but irreversible crossing still loses its no-return and committed-consequence relations.
